decision.caveat: one seed, exposed Test split; the thresholds are engineering decisions, not significance tests, and this round has no capacity-matched STATIC control
decision.label: POSSIBLE_DYNAMIC_SIGNAL
decision.reason: overall gain in the 0.005..0.010 band or offset by low-support tasks

mechanism.boundary: message_off / message_shuffle are post-training input interventions. They measure sensitivity to the real message correspondence, not a causal generalisation gain, and they are not equivalent to an independently trained capacity-matched STATIC control.
mechanism.label: post-training Validation-only input intervention (not a trained control)

robustness.note: descriptive only. The official macro AP is the reported number; these decompositions only show whether the difference is broad or a few-task artefact.

scored_task_ids.note: a task is scored only if at least one labelled positive exists in the split; the excluded id is never part of any macro average

validation_vs_test_per_task.note: descriptive agreement between the two splits, not a leakage or significance test

test_common_validation_and_test_ge20.definition: official Test positives >= 20 and both Validation positive counts >= 20
